model_source.model: ABM v5 hierarchical opportunity + local realization

held_out_system.name: Aride Island seasonal plant-flower visitor network
held_out_system.dryad_file_stream_provenance: File stream IDs were resolved from the Dryad DOI page links after the validation estimands and decision rule were frozen, before any CSV numeric matrix content was downloaded or inspected.
held_out_system.weight_definition: visitation frequency in visits flower^-1 h^-1
held_out_system.independence: three seasonal networks are repeated local realizations within one independent island system, not three independent archipelagos

selection_caveat: The public paper/Dryad abstract was known at freeze and reports seasonal changes in composition, specialization and species roles. Therefore system selection is not literature-blind. However, the two frozen target estimands below and their numeric matrix-derived values were not calculated or inspected before this freeze. Treat this as target-estimand-blind independent validation, not a fully outcome-blind system-selection experiment.

source_gate.exact_download_rule: Download only the exact Dryad file_stream IDs frozen above. Require successful CSV parsing, finite non-negative weights, unique non-empty plant/pollinator labels, and checksum-lock all three source payloads before metric calculation.
source_gate.blocked_rule: If any required matrix cannot be checksum-locked from the Dryad DOI version, do not substitute reconstructed, binary, pooled-season, or paper-table networks.

network_inclusion_rule: Use all rows and columns in each of the three source-native quantitative matrices after only structural parsing of plant-name row labels and pollinator-name column labels. Do not drop taxa, links or seasons by v5 fit or metric direction.

island_opportunity_input.matching_rule: Resolve Aride Island by exact/normalized name with the Dryad coordinates as a geography-only plausibility check. Do not use network metrics in matching.
island_opportunity_input.mapping: Apply the existing v4 primary mainland-distance ECDF mapping against the already-frozen v4 reference island geography; the held-out Aride observation must not be inserted into the reference ECDF.
island_opportunity_input.held_out_ecdf_extension: Use piecewise-linear interpolation on the sorted unique frozen reference distances and their original index/(n-1) ECDF values; clamp below/above the frozen reference range to 0/1. This exactly preserves the original v4 mapping at every frozen reference distance.

v5_predictive_distribution.synthetic_unit: For each opportunity x saturation x strength evolution replicate, hold the feasible v4 network fixed and draw exactly three independent unlabeled v5 local contexts, matching the three held-out seasonal networks.
v5_predictive_distribution.empty_feasible_state_rule: If v4 produces an empty feasible state, record both target three-context ranges as exactly zero for predictive-variability purposes and separately count the empty state. This preserves equal setting weights and treats an empty opportunity set as predicting no local architecture variation, rather than silently dropping model collapse.
v5_predictive_distribution.single_pollinator_state_rule: A positive one-pollinator feasible state is structurally non-branchable under v5 and therefore contributes target range zero, consistent with the #191 synthetic gate.

primary_statistics.interaction_shannon_range: max(interaction_shannon across the three seasons) - min(interaction_shannon across the three seasons)
primary_statistics.plant_niche_overlap_range: max(mean plant niche overlap across the three seasons) - min(mean plant niche overlap across the three seasons)
primary_statistics.transition_signs: Record Early->Mid and Mid->Late signed differences for each target as descriptive branching information only; v5 predicts no seasonal direction and does not require both signs with only two transitions.
primary_statistics.v4_zero_context_comparator: At context_strength=0 the local range is exactly zero by construction and is reported only as the inherited v4 comparator, not mixed into the primary v5 predictive distribution.

decision_rule.variation_necessary_condition: Both empirical target ranges must be strictly greater than zero unless every parsed seasonal network is structurally non-branchable with one pollinator; this exception must be determined from source dimensions, not metric values.
decision_rule.predictive_adequacy: For each target separately, the empirical three-season range must fall within the prespecified 2.5th-97.5th percentile envelope of the equal-weight pooled v5 range distribution across all frozen nonzero strengths and saturations, including zero-range predictions from empty/single-pollinator synthetic states.
decision_rule.headline: v5 survives this held-out raw seasonal test only if both target metrics satisfy the variation necessary condition and predictive-adequacy envelope. Failure of either target is retained as empirical v5 failure; no strength/saturation may be selected post hoc.

prohibited_after_matrix_download: drop any of the three seasons
drop taxa or links by model fit
choose a context strength or saturation by Aride fit
map October/November/December labels to special synthetic affinity values
change the 2.5-97.5% predictive envelope after seeing the empirical ranges
change the empty/single-partner predictive handling after seeing Aride
pool Aride with the blocked 2017 Mahé dataset as if they were one experiment
claim_boundary: Aride is one held-out island with three seasonal local networks. Passing would support the v5 local-realization variability class at the frozen raw-matrix estimands, not identify a seasonal mechanism, context-strength value, universal affinity distribution, restoration effect, or global island coefficient.
